Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Thread-safe controller that manages the game flow for a single game of Mesos. All public methods are synchronized. Phase transitions are handled internally. Public methods accept string identifiers resolved to domain objects via ResourceFinder. isGameStillActive is checked at the start of every method so threads waiting on the lock after the game ends will fail fast instead of operating on a terminated game.

    • addPlayer

      public void addPlayer(String playerNickname, Color color, GameObserver obs) throws LobbyException, GameInvariantException
      Adds a player to the lobby. Starts the game automatically when the lobby is full.
      Parameters:
      playerNickname - nickname of the player
      color - chosen totem color
      obs - observer for this player
      Throws:
      LobbyException - if nickname/color already taken or lobby is full
      GameInvariantException - if a game invariant is violated

    • handleDisconnection

      public boolean handleDisconnection(String playerID)
      Handles a player disconnection. If the game has not started, removes the player from the lobby. If the game is running, crashes it for all remaining players.
      Parameters:
      playerID - nickname of the disconnected player
      Returns:
      true if the game is still active, false if it was terminated.
